text:
sylvia: Quick heads up — we need to open a quota/support case for APAC (ap-southeast-1) A100 capacity plus ENI/EIP increases to cover a Dedicated pool burst for the upcoming marketing campaign. Forecasts below; asking for approval to submit now.

infra_bot: automated capacity snapshot: ap-southeast-1 — GPU util 72%, free A100-equivalent nodes: 6, current Dedicated baseline GPUs: 40, expected peak demand next 30d: ~60 GPUs, suggested headroom: +20. ENI usage 48/50, EIP usage 12/50.

raj: can you paste the exact instance families and count (eg p4d, a100-80gb) and whether these are on-demand/reserved requests? support needs explicit quota names + numbers.

sylvia: we should ask for A100-80GB (p4d or equivalent) — request raising EC2 GPU instance limit to 60 GPUs (from 40). Prefer on-demand capacity for burst window; we'll convert later if needed. Also request ENI limit bump from 50 -> 150 and Elastic IPs from 50 -> 120 in that region. Justification: 2-week campaign with 2x peak traffic, customer SLAs require <1200ms p95.

maria: I can file but need: 1) exact quota keys (we can use "EC2 On-Demand Instances (p4d.24xlarge)" as proxy), 2) VPC IDs and account IDs, 3) 7/30 day utilization graphs and a short business justification. If you paste a draft I can submit.

raj: draft support case below — please tweak as needed and we can paste to AWS support: ```Subject: APAC (ap-southeast-1) temporary quota increase request for GPU burst and network interfaces

Body:
Account: 123456789012
VPCs: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f
Requested Changes:
- EC2 On-Demand Instances (p4d.24xlarge / A100-80GB equivalent): increase from 40 -> 60 (temporary, 30 days)
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) regional limit: increase from 50 -> 150
- Elastic IPs: increase from 50 -> 120

Reason: Upcoming product launch requires short-term Dedicated pool burst capacity to maintain latency SLOs for premium customers. Past 30-day telemetry shows sustained baseline at ~65% with predicted campaign peak requiring ~60 GPUs. We will return to baseline and notify support when scale-down occurs.

Attachments: 7/30 day CPU/GPU utilization, requestor contact info, rollback plan.
```

maria: change ENI target to 250 -> many NICs per GPU host for NVLink and multi-enclave setups. But if you want conservative ask, 150 is ok. Also include a contact phone and escalation alias.

cloud_ops: alternative idea — add cross-region fallback to eu-west-1 as soft fallback if quotas delayed. That buys time without bumping quotas immediately. Also consider using spot for non-SLA workloads to reduce cost.

tom: cost note — rough delta: +~$2.2k/day if fully used (on-demand p4d-equivalent). Approve if marketing signs off. Also add rollback: if support denied, reduce burst to 10 GPUs and enable cross-region routing.

sylvia: marketing signed off earlier. I'll attach Grafana 7/30 day graphs and the account/VPC IDs, add contact alias infra-ops@redwood.com. No objections? planning to ask @maria to file within next 30m.

maria: filing now. Case created: CASE-2026-APAC-321. Tags: "quota-increase","apac","dedicated-burst". AWS target turnaround 72h. Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:

infra_bot: case update — CASE-2026-APAC-321 opened by maria at 1885001345, status: pending. Estimated response SLA 72h. Current regional headroom suggestion: provision temporary warm-pool of 12 GPUs if approved.

sylvia: thanks everyone — I'll follow up once AWS responds. If CASE approved we'll coordinate Dedicated capacity onboarding and autoscaling policies with eng-runtime.
